podcast.title: One-Album Band
podcast.body: Zwan was a band that released one album and reunited Billy Corgan with Jimmy Chamberlin after the initial Smashing Pumpkins breakup. "and a one album band called Zwan which reunited him with Jimmy Chamberlain."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Short-Lived Band
podcast.body: Zwan was a short-lived band formed by Billy Corgan after the breakup of The Smashing Pumpkins, featuring Slint guitarist David Pajo. "In fact, when Billy Corrigan broke up the smashing pumpkins, he recruited Slint guitarist David Peio for this short-lived band called Zwan."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: What Exactly is Post Rock? Part 2

podcast.title: Short-Lived Project
podcast.body: Zwan, formed by Billy Corgan and Jimmy Chamberlain after The Smashing Pumpkins' breakup, lasted for "exactly one album" before the group fell apart. "Zwan, however, lasted exactly one album before they fell apart."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
